column3: The related Non-Serviced Master Servicer earns a primary servicing fee with respect to each of the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel Mortgage Loan, the 255 Greenwich Mortgage Loan and the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan that is to be calculated based on a rate equal to (i) 0.00125% per annum, with respect to the Sheraton Denver Downtown Hotel Mortgage Loan and (ii) 0.00250% per annum, with respect to the 255 Greenwich Mortgage Loan and the Ellenton Premium Outlets Mortgage Loan.
